name: vouch
description: Fixture-first Vouch workspace, Check worker, and review experience

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci && uv sync --project services/backend --locked
scripts.dev:fixture: cross-env VOUCH_AUTH_MODE=fixture NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_MODE=fixture concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,worker,retention,web -c blue,magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:retention" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:authenticated: cross-env VOUCH_AUTH_MODE=supabase NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_MODE=supabase concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,worker,retention,web -c blue,magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev:api:authenticated" "npm run dev:worker:authenticated" "npm run dev:retention:authenticated" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:hosted: cross-env VOUCH_AUTH_MODE=supabase NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_MODE=supabase concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,worker,retention,web -c blue,magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev:api:hosted" "npm run dev:worker:hosted" "npm run dev:retention:hosted" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.meta:probe: uv run --project services/backend --no-sync --env-file services/backend/.env.worker python -m vouch_backend.meta_probe
scripts.meta:smoke:spark: uv run --project services/backend --no-sync --env-file services/backend/.env.worker python -m vouch_backend.meta_smoke --confirm-paid-synthetic-call
scripts.lint: uv run --project services/backend ruff check services/backend && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.typecheck: uv run --project services/backend mypy services/backend/src && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.test: uv run --project services/backend pytest services/backend/tests -q && npm --prefix apps/web run test
scripts.test:e2e:authenticated: cross-env VOUCH_E2E_AUTH=supabase npm --prefix apps/web run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:decoded: cross-env VOUCH_E2E_AUTH=supabase VOUCH_E2E_MEDIA=decoded npm --prefix apps/web run test:e2e
scripts.test:media: cross-env VOUCH_TEST_MEDIA=1 uv run --project services/backend pytest services/backend/tests/test_media.py services/backend/tests/test_media_finalization.py -q
scripts.test:authenticated: cross-env VOUCH_TEST_AUTHENTICATED=1 uv run --project services/backend pytest services/backend/tests/test_authenticated_integration.py services/backend/tests/test_authenticated_retention.py -q
scripts.openapi: uv run --project services/backend vouch-openapi && npm --prefix apps/web run types:api
scripts.contracts:check: uv run --project services/backend vouch-openapi --check && npm --prefix apps/web run types:api:check
scripts.check: npm run contracts:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
